item.description:
New

  • Open the official OpenAI usage page from a link at the bottom of the OpenAI usage card to check usage and manage billing.

Improved

  • Redesign attention inbox rows to match the menu panel, with View Details as the primary action and Archive always available.
  • Show a single notice at the top of the inbox when history is truncated, with the sync window in days and the number of items, instead of inline hints.
  • Mark rows for ended or unlocated sessions as unavailable and exclude them from the count of items that need attention.

Fixed

  • Improve the contrast of pending-approval text in light appearance so it stays readable.

Note

  • Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
